item.title: Reshh - Social Media Platform for Bengal's Indies
item.description:
Reshh is a social media platform designed specifically for Bengal’s independent creators—musicians, game developers, artists, and other creative professionals. The platform serves as a dedicated space where these creators can showcase their work, connect with audiences, and build a community around independent creative expression.

The idea emerged from recognizing the need for a localized platform that understands and celebrates the unique creative ecosystem of Bengal. While global platforms exist, they often don’t provide the focused community and discovery mechanisms that independent creators need to gain visibility and connect with their target audience.
